content.heading: Two-Wheeler Loan
content.text: KMPL offers Two-Wheeler Finance for a range of vehicles for a period from 12 months to 60 months, with funding up to 100% of the on-road price.

sections.notes: Background photo with text content block left-aligned on desktop (default justify-content/items-start), no CTA. Mobile section height (600) differs slightly from desktop (672).

content.text: Activities such as Application Login, Credit approval, e-agreement, Repayment mandate set-up, online disbursement, etc are carried out online.
content.text2: Increase in EMI after every year, six months or quarter (depending upon your needs).

items.q: Which Two- Wheelers can be financed by KMPL?
items.a: KMPL finances almost all two-wheelers manufactured by leading automobile companies in India. We also finance imported bikes subject to fulfilment of certain terms and conditions and basis the credit discretion of KMPL.
